messages:
Priya: Quick check-in on the 90-day incident inventory. I ran a lightweight cluster of incidents and noticed 4 recurrent themes. Want to agree owners and realistic small-scoped fixes.

Jorge: drop the themes pls

Priya: Themes: (A) bursty downstream rate limits -> queue buildup, (B) autoscaler drift on threshold YAMLs, (C) rollout overlap causing duplicate model serving, (D) cache eviction storms after GC.

Nora: +1. Which of these are highest impact?

Priya: Impact by frequency and customer hit: A > C > B > D. Also A has highest monthly cost.

Ben: Proposed micro-actions (21d) per theme: A: add per-host leaky-bucket and immediate shed + alert; C: prevent overlapping deploys via a simple lock and pre-check; B: add CI lint and a nightly config compare job; D: add eviction jitter + smoothing. Assign owners?

Jorge: I'll take A. Ben take C? Nora B? Priya D?

Ben: I can take C but suggest a canary safety net rather than lock at first.

Nora: I'll own B. Will scope as "lint + drift detector" and aim to have PR by end of week.

Priya: D will be a small runtime tweak; I'll prototype TTL jitter and run a short perf test. ETA 2026-05-25.

PagerBot: INC-FOLLUP-2026-1201 created and assigned -> Jorge, due 2026-06-03.

Jorge: For A, question: do we want host-only shedding or a shared token service? I think host-first, shared later.

Priya: host-first. We'll measure reduction. If still an issue, move to shared quota in Q3.

Ben: For C I'll implement the pre-check + abort policy and publish a playbook snippet for runbooks. ETA 2026-05-29.

Nora: PR opened for B by EOD Friday. Will add alert on config drift and a rollback safety gate.

Priya: Agree we should tag all related postmortems with "followup/pending" and add a column "regression?" in the tracker. I'll push a CSV to trackers and link here.

Jorge: One blocker: need test env access to simulate high downstream latencies. @Ben can you share infra contact?

Ben: Yep, open ticket INF-4823 and cc me. I'll expedite.

Priya: Scheduling a 30m recurring sync monthly to keep this small. First meetup 2026-05-20 16:00 PT. Invite sent.

Nora: small ask: can we add an "est. cost avoided/month" column so PMs can prioritize?

Priya: Good idea. Adding that to the tracker.

Jorge: Ack. I'll update status in the tracker as I make progress.

Ben: Will link PRs and playbook changes into the follow-up ticket.

Priya: Thanks all. If anyone gets blocked, reply in-thread with ticket IDs. Closing this thread once tracker reflects assigned owners + ETAs.

Jorge: ack

Nora: ack

Ben: ack
